verdict.rationale: The evidence offers no dedicated sandbox or test-environment feature. It only implies a workaround: the CLI can list and switch between multiple applications (algolia-docs-30), and the quickstart indexes sample data rather than real data (algolia-docs-1, algolia-docs-18), so a user could keep a separate non-production app. A/B testing runs live, so it does not count as isolation. missing for 10: documented sandbox/staging environment, explicit guidance on isolating test from production data, test API keys or environments for agents, independent corroboration.
